title: shop.ovsbm
summary: An experimental online store for my A/W 2023 collection of AI-designed clothing and prints. I designed it, launched it and sold out in three months.

sections.head: Turning art into a product
sections.body: The AI-generated work had been building for a while: surrealist architecture, editorial fashion and metallic figure studies, all sitting in folders. I wanted to know if anyone would buy it, and how to get it to market without a production team or a warehouse.

sections.head: Test the concept, move the stock
sections.body: Run a lean, self-contained launch: design the collection, build the store, run the campaigns, and see if it sold.

sections.head: Sold out in three months
sections.body: The A/W 2023 collection launched through a Shopify store with a campaign site matching the aesthetic of the work. All stock sold within three months.
